query:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(raw.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS started_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw.name LIKE 'workflow.execute %' THEN 'workflow.execute'
         WHEN raw.name LIKE 'workflow.start %' THEN 'workflow.start'
         ELSE raw.name END AS stage,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(raw.trace_id))) AS trace_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(raw.span_id))) AS span_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(raw.parent_span_id))) AS parent_hex,
    raw.status_code,
    toFloatOrNull(raw.attributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 200
        AND toFloatOrNull(raw.attributes['http.response.status_code']) < 300 AS http_2xx,
    length(raw.links) AS link_count,
    if(length(raw.links) = 1 AND isValidJSON(arrayElement(raw.links, 1)),
       lower(hex(base64Decode(JSONExtractString(arrayElement(raw.links, 1), 'trace_id')))), '') AS link_trace_hex,
    if(length(raw.links) = 1 AND isValidJSON(arrayElement(raw.links, 1)),
       lower(hex(base64Decode(JSONExtractString(arrayElement(raw.links, 1), 'span_id')))), '') AS link_span_hex
FROM posthog.trace_spans raw
WHERE raw.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:00:00', 'UTC')
  AND raw.timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:10:00', 'UTC')
  AND raw.service_name = 'mikka-web'
  AND (raw.resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'] = 'production'
       OR raw.resource_attributes['deployment.environment'] = 'production')
  AND raw.trace_id IN (base64Encode(unhex('d800cdfe653e7cb1dd4f60c079008f82')), 's7W2IvgvPyQj8LrQKd8P5A==')
  AND (raw.name IN ('workflow.route.flow', 'vqs.process', 'workflow.execute', 'workflow.start')
       OR raw.name LIKE 'workflow.execute %' OR raw.name LIKE 'workflow.start %')
ORDER BY raw.timestamp, raw.span_id
LIMIT 50
context: One read-only historical topology inspection authorized for issue #1512. Exact already-observed invocation trace d800cdfe653e7cb1dd4f60c079008f82 and its recorded sole link target only, fixed 10-minute window; names, opaque parent/link IDs and numeric success flags only. Not a metric, model invocation, or production acceptance. Schema reused from prior alert-entry-links-schema.json; no attribute bags or user content.
